description: MEH, short for Miscellaneous Enhancements for Hypixel, is a convenience mod that introduces features to have a better experience on Hypixel.

mods.name: MEH
mods.description:
Miscellaneous Enhancements for Hypixel. Enhance the Hypixel experience with random quality of life additions.

This mod contains features that may be useful while playing on Hypixel without making the game feel overly modded for any reason.
